record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Rockruff (1 star) and the three Lycanroc forms (2 stars) declare ABILITY ACCELEROCK; all have range 1 and maxPP 100. The Lycanroc forms also declare passive LYCANROC (weather form switching), which is a separate queue record and is not covered.
record.summary: Dash and strike. The caster picks the farthest targetable enemy that has a free adjacent cell, teleports (swaps cells) to the free cell next to it that is farthest from the caster's start, retargets that enemy and deals special damage of atk x a per-star factor to it. Afterwards the caster loses defense and gains speed: nbEffects = min(floor(def/2), round(5 x (1 + AP/100) x critPower-if-crit)); defense -2 x nbEffects, speed +5 x nbEffects.

targeting.who: the farthest enemy (Manhattan-style distanceM) with a free adjacent cell; if no enemy has a free adjacent cell, the farthest enemy and the closest free place to it; if no destination exists the original cast target is used and the caster does not move
targeting.note: requiresTarget keeps the default true. The strategy overrides the target with destination.target when a destination exists. Whether the first-found farthest enemy wins ties was read as strictly greater distance only (targetDistance > maxTargetDistance), so the first scanned enemy of the maximum distance is kept; scan order is board.forEach.

geometry.shape: single target at the farthest enemy; movement by swapping the caster into a free cell adjacent to that enemy
geometry.detail: getAdjacentCells (8 neighbours) filtered to empty cells, the one farthest from the caster wins (strictly greater distance); fallback getClosestAvailablePlace around the farthest enemy.

effects.scaling: handleSpecialDamage(atk x factor, board, SPECIAL, caster, crit, apBoost true): damage + damage x AP/100, DOUBLE_DAMAGE x2, strange-steam x1.2, crit multiplies by 1 + (critPower - 1) x reduction factor (only if crit, which needs ABILITY_CRIT). The base uses the caster's current atk.
effects.resolution: handleSpecialDamage then state.handleDamage (defence, shields and item hooks not read). Blocked completely if the target has protect, skydiving or magicBounce (magicBounce reflects).

declaredRaw.nbEffects: min(floor(def/2), round(5 x (1 + AP/100) x (critPower if crit)))

effects.scaling: nbEffects uses the caster's def BEFORE the loss and its AP; addDefense and addSpeed are called with apBoost 0 so no second AP scaling; item hooks (Big Eater Belt, Twist Band) run inside both. Defense is floored at 0.
effects.resolution: addDefense: round, hooks, def = max(0, def + value). addSpeed: hooks, clamp 0..MAX_SPEED.
moveTo swaps cells with whatever is there (the destination is a free cell), puts the caster into MovingState and sets cooldown 100.

starBehavior.note: Caster stars index the damage factor table (1, 1.25, 2.5; fallback 2.5). The self-buff does not depend on stars, only on AP, crit and current def. Catalog units are 1 or 2 stars.

record.positionalConditions: Needs at least one targetable enemy for movement; with no free cell anywhere near the farthest enemy, destination is null and the cast stays in place on the original target.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast again lowers def (to a floor of 0, so nbEffects falls to 0 once def < 2) and raises speed.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw damage: atk x 1 / 1.25 / 2.5 for 1 / 2 / 3 stars before AP and crit scaling. Defense/speed change counts are capped by half the caster's current defense.
